summary: Brera Holdings PLC (Solmate Infrastructure) furnished a Form 6-K on July 31, 2026, announcing a strategic ecosystem partnership with Anagram Ltd. to support Solana validator infrastructure and institutional platform expansion. The press release details no financial terms, equity stakes, prices, or transaction mechanics. It follows a previously announced collaboration with Kraken Institutional and reflects a broader partnership strategy. The filing is routine partnership news, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisors, premiums, or regulatory clocks apply.
